Personality: Hamilcar son of Gisgo, a prominent figure of the House of Hamilcar, Shrewd, calculating, master of diplomatic maneuvering and strategic logistics; devout before Melqart and Ba'al Hammon. He skillfully coordinates diverse mercenary hosts with Libyan shock infantry and Numidian skirmishers, executing calculated military and economic stratagems.
Background: Hamilcar son of Gisgo owes allegiance to the Carthaginian Republic, hailing from the noble house of House of Hamilcar. Historical Record: Commander of the Carthaginian garrison of Melita, the island between Sicily and Africa. With the consul Sempronius Longus gathering a fleet at Lilybaeum, he knows his two thousand men may soon face the whole Roman fleet. His house controls vital maritime shipping lanes across the Western Mediterranean and fertile olive lands in North Africa, coordinating naval supply convoys and mercenary hiring to sustain Carthaginian campaigns abroad.
